40000043f84d7ac4.meaning: itmModdableSetId: the item's modifier set, a key of itmModifierSets (dacef5518) in itmModifierSetTablePrototype. It is the per-item link to the stat-split packages that #332 asked for; itmModifierSetID 0xacec47da does not exist in this client.
40000043f84d7ac4.evidence: On 4,866 of 131,396 items (itm.eq.random 2,585, itm.gen.random 1,553, itm.mod.enhancement *.rand.* 285, itm.gen.sow 200, itm.mod.mod 114, barrel/armoring/hilt 38 each); 4,856 resolve to one of the 338 sets. 0xacec47da is on 0 items and in no client.gom property. Only 8 of these items also carry itmEquipModStats. Tool: kessel-discovery/examples/items_modsets.py.

4000003534ae42aa.meaning: itmModSetPackageSmallId: a package of a modifier set, the key of itmModifierPackagesList (4e32e7ebe8), whose itmModPkgAttributePercentages give the stat split.
4000003534ae42aa.evidence: All 1,195 distinct values in itmModifierSets are keys of the 1,312-entry package table. The enhancement set of itm.mod.enhancement.ilvl_0134.legendary.rand.att_crit_end_pwr lists packages 1477..1496: endurance 70 with power 50..69 and critical 130..111 permille, the 20 rolls of a random enhancement.

400000249d4ed5c3.meaning: itmModPkgAttributePercentages: one variant's STAT -> permille of the item budget. A package's 1 to 3 variants are the components of one piece and are summed: each stat is the sum over variants of item_budget_table(quality, item level - 1, permille).
400000249d4ed5c3.evidence: 313 fixed-stat itm.eq items (item_stats) are reproduced exactly, every stat, by one package at list index item_level-1, and all 313 lie inside that package variant's itmModPkgMinLevel..MaxLevel. Controls: index item_level gives 31, item_level-2 gives 1, item_level-5 gives 5. Example itm.eq.cc.yuun.waist.medium.premium.cc_07x1 (level 48): package 492 endurance 180, mastery 300, power 20 -> 37, 56, 5 = item_stats. Summed variants reproduce 1,482 more fixed items exactly (206 at item level, 204 at level - 2), e.g. itm.gen.synthweaving.tank.ilvl_0032.prototype.armor_head = package 1249's three variants -> 41 / 30 / 17 / 16.

40000004d73288ae.meaning: itmModPkgMinLevel: lowest item level at which this package may roll for an item of a modifier set; the same on every variant of the package.
40000004d73288ae.evidence: Every one of the 4,856 items with a resolving itmModdableSetId has a package whose range covers its level, and for 2,707 the range admits a strict subset of the set (itm.eq.random.wrists.medium.premium.level_024_force: packages in 1-20, 18-36, 28-70, 71-90; level 24 admits only 18-36). All variants of a package share the range (140 of 140), and the 1,482 fixed items built from summed variants lie outside it, so it gates rolls and does not choose a variant. RESEARCH 01a1c30d-73cd rev 2; tool items_package_variants.py.

40000004d73288b0.meaning: itmModPkgMaxLevel: highest item level at which this package may roll for an item of a modifier set.
40000004d73288b0.evidence: Every one of the 4,856 items with a resolving itmModdableSetId has a package whose range covers its level, and for 2,707 the range admits a strict subset of the set (itm.eq.random.wrists.medium.premium.level_024_force: packages in 1-20, 18-36, 28-70, 71-90; level 24 admits only 18-36). All variants of a package share the range (140 of 140), and the 1,482 fixed items built from summed variants lie outside it, so it gates rolls and does not choose a variant. RESEARCH 01a1c30d-73cd rev 2; tool items_package_variants.py.

400000249d4ed5c1.meaning: itmBudgetedAttributes: quality -> list of 200 levels -> list of 1,000 permille slots -> stat points. The level list is 0-based: list index i is item level i+1, so item_budget_table.item_level is item level minus 1.
400000249d4ed5c1.evidence: Every stat of every single mod (itm.mod.*, 21,932 items) lies in the budget row at index item_level-1 for 21,884 items, against 20,162 at index item_level and 20,507 at item_level-5; all 512 armorings, 2,746 mods, 2,630 enhancements, 1,009 barrels and 348 hilts hit at item_level-1. Package reproduction peaks at the same offset (see 400000249d4ed5c3).

4000000a2d7b8780.meaning: itmEquipSetBonus: the gear set the item belongs to, a key of itmSetBonuses (2d7b877e) in itmSetBonusesPrototype.
4000000a2d7b8780.evidence: On 4,411 items; all 4,411 resolve to one of 218 sets, 171 of which have member items. Survivor's Gear (297049677576016420) has 20 items, 2 pieces -> abl.itm.setbonus.endgame_pvp.htank1.light.02_01 'Reduces cooldown of Spike or Spinning Kick by 10 seconds.' Tool: items_set_bonuses.py.

4000000a2d7b8781.meaning: itmSetBonusBonuses: pieces worn -> the set-bonus ability granted at that count.
4000000a2d7b8781.evidence: 659 entries in 218 sets; piece keys 2 (213), 3 (31), 4 (216), 5 (36), 6 (133), 7 (30). All 367 abilities resolve to abl.itm.setbonus.* or test FQNs and 657 of 659 rows have effect text (str.abl id1=1); the two without are abl.test.dhunt.itemset01/02. 17 texts carry <<N>> tokens, which resolve through ablDescriptionTokenEffect.

400000164512e6c1.meaning: itmEnhancementSlots: the item's mod slots, each a key of itmEnhancementTypes (734860ef): modulator (the augment slot), circuitry (mod), support (enhancement), harness (armoring), hilt, barrel, colorCrystal, dyePack, tuning; 0 = empty position.
400000164512e6c1.evidence: Every non-zero value is one of the 9 keys of itmEnhancementInfoPrototype.734860ef, whose 3353ec87 strings name them. Mod items' itmEnhancementType agrees: itm.mod.augment (169) and itm.mod.modulator -> modulator, armoring/harness -> harness, mod/overlay -> circuitry, enhancement/support -> support, hilt/power_crystal -> hilt, barrel -> barrel.

4000000f734860f1.meaning: itmEnhancementType: the slot type a mod item fits, a key of itmEnhancementTypes (734860ef).
4000000f734860f1.evidence: 23,086 items; families map one to one (itm.mod.augment 169 and itm.mod.modulator 1,341 -> modulator; itm.mod.armoring 550 and harness 3,592 -> harness; itm.mod.mod 1,546 and overlay 4,541 -> circuitry; itm.mod.enhancement 2,915 and support 4,434 -> support).

4000002f55809161.meaning: itmEnhancementDefaults: the mod item pre-slotted in each position of itmEnhancementSlots (0 = empty). A moddable shell's displayed stats are the sum of its slotted mods' itmEquipModStats.
4000002f55809161.evidence: In game, slotted mod stats add to the item: Sean's 340 Fearless Victor implant shows 1223 / 1594 / 1084 / 722 = its itmEquipModStats 1223 / 1450 / 940 / 614 + augments 144 / 144 / 108 (reflection 019e7b20). 23,604 items have defaults and no own stats; Onderonian Eliminator's Offhand Blaster's three defaults (Versatile Barrel 74, Lethal Mod 74A, Nimble Enhancement 74, as Jedipedia lists) sum to 672 / 610 / 341 / 284. RESEARCH 01a1c30d-73cd rev 2.

4000000ba38ca337.meaning: ablDescriptionTokenEffect: the effect a description token <<N>> reads, as its effNumber (2efdc39f) among the effect variants of the same ability.
4000000ba38ca337.evidence: 2,845 of 3,026 Duration tokens resolve to an effect with an effDuration. Every relic proc agrees with Sean's combat logs: Power, Critical and Mastery Surge <<1>> = effect 2 = 6 s (log windows 6.0-6.1 s, 7,531 / 1,758 / 6,587), <<2>> = effect 3 = 20 s (minimum apply gap 20.0 s); Healing Resonance 3 s and 20 s; Alacrity Boost 30 s; Absorb Shield 10 s. abl.agent.evasion <<1>> = effect 1 = 4 s, which Jedipedia also shows; the 3 s in #320 is effect 2 (Blow for Blow). Tool: ability_token_values.py.

4000000a384b793c.meaning: ablDescriptionTokenMultiplier: the count the effect's value is multiplied by for the displayed number (Duration: multiplier x effDuration; a heal-over-time: ticks x heal).
4000000a384b793c.evidence: 1.0 on every relic Duration token, whose values match the logs. Healing Resonance's Healing token has 4.0 on a 3 s heal-over-time, and 176 of 178 procs in Sean's logs heal exactly 4 times. RESEARCH 01a1c30d-7541 rev 2.

4000004ec802b2a8.meaning: The NPC's own ability packages (apn), a list of AnimationPackage refs. With its class's package (1d72ea3a) they carry the NPC's passives, including boss health passives and per-mode passives (abl.exp.seasons.multi.difficulty_modes.*).
4000004ec802b2a8.evidence: Walking these packages' ablPackageAbilitiesList (f4787f5b) reaches the health passive of every boss tested: npc.exp.seasons.02.ep_09.story.valkorion lists apn.exp.seasons.02.ep_09.bosses.valkorion, whose passive adds 9,566,190 to the 506,305 base for his logged 10,072,495; Shae Vizla, Sairisi, Ortuno, Stivastin, Master Oric Traless and Mentor reproduce their logged max HP from the 2,952,392 base. RESEARCH 01a1c30f-29f2 rev 3; tool npc_health_walk.py.

4000000a1d72ea3a.meaning: The class's ability package (apn), given to every NPC of the class; the second source of an NPC's passives besides the NPC's own list (c802b2a8).
4000000a1d72ea3a.evidence: class.npc.humanoid.boss.flashpoint.raid.eternity_vault.difficulty_3.boss_soa -> apn.npc.combat.flashpoint.raid.eternity_vault.difficulty_3.boss_soa. Its 2,094 values reference AnimationPackage rows. The walk through both sources reproduces logged boss max HP (RESEARCH 01a1c30f-29f2).
